name: darkmux-viewer-e2e
description: Headless browser e2e gate for the observability viewer (the React port under ui/src/, built to crates/darkmux-serve/assets/next.html). Dev-only; not part of the shipped binary. The WHOLE suite runs in ~11s, so it is the fast loop for anything rendered — prefer it over the ~10min cargo workspace suite when the change is UI (#1622).
